Question: The number \(5^{867}\) is between \(2^{2013}\) and \(2^{2014}.\) How many pairs of integers \((m,n)\) are there such that \(1\le m\le2012\) and \[5^n\lt2^m\lt2^{m+2}\lt5^{n+1}?\]
